verdict.rationale: An IP office could plausibly publish developer SDKs or APIs, so this story applies to DPMA. The evidence pack shows only web portals (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb) and the downloadable DPMAdirektPro filing application. That is end-user filing software, not an official SDK, and nothing in the pack documents client libraries or developer kits.
